name: pantheon
description: Pantheon — coordination layer for AI personas. Persona identity, memory, real-time chat, and session lifecycle in one daemon. CC-side UX layer over the vanilla MCP server.

pantheon.description: Vanilla MCP server. Serves the full pantheon tool surface (persona / memory / chat / spawn / lifecycle) over stdio.

statusline.description: One-line summary of connected agents (per-project, asterisks for guests).

PreToolUse.description: Per §14: reset the watchdog on every CC tool-use event so plugin-mode gets the richer activity signal vanilla MCP can't see.

PostToolUse.description: After /color: persist the new color to the claimed persona via update_profile.

UserPromptSubmit.description: Auto-context-percent nudge per §6 HIGH. Emits a chat DM at 70% / 85% / 95% with the recommended action.

notes: Variables: ${PANTHEON_HOME} = pantheon repo root; ${plugin_dir} = this plugin's install dir; ${PANTHEON_BIN} = ${PANTHEON_HOME}/bin.
Hooks ship as best-effort stubs today — they declare the intent + script entry point. Full daemon-side wiring lands when the §15 singleton daemon ships.
Settings-templates are install-time scaffolds: copy snippet contents into your ~/.claude/settings.json under the relevant role folder. The plugin does NOT auto-overwrite your existing settings.
Tab-title-from-status hook is Windows-only (WT/kitty/wezterm adapters); see plugin/hooks/tab-title.sh.
